about: This game is optimized for PS5™ (4K resolution). Cross-save functionality is available: your profile, including progression, all purchases, and inventory are automatically shared.
Discover For Honor®, a groundbreaking melee action game developed by Ubisoft Montreal in collaboration with other Ubisoft studios.
Choose your warrior amongst the bold Knights, brutal Vikings, and deadly Samurai.
Storm castles and fortresses in massive battles and confront bosses in intense duels.
For Honor offers single-player mode, offline campaign, and thrilling multiplayer.
INNOVATIVE ART OF BATTLE CONTROL SYSTEM
Wield the weight of your weapon. Feel the power of every strike.
